text: TORQUE. Knock out leverage on NVDA, settled in USDG, on Robinhood Chain.

Robinhood Chain holds almost seven hundred million dollars of Paxos USDG, and stock tokens trade around the clock. But only one point two four million dollars is lent against stock tokens on chain, and ninety eight percent of it is already borrowed. The NVDA market alone is a hundred percent used. People want leverage on stocks. The dollars to fund it are not there.
TORQUE is leverage with its own liquidity. Pick NVDA, choose two to five times, and pay in USDG. The most you can ever lose is what you put in. There are no margin calls.

When you open, the vault lends the rest, and the whole position is bought as real NVDA in the on chain Uniswap pool, within one percent of Chainlink's price. If Chainlink prints at your knock out level, anyone can close the position. The vault is repaid first, and the rest is yours.

The hard part is keeping the LP vault solvent, so that was the main design job. Every position is fully hedged with real NVDA. Exposure is capped in the contract. And two safety checks run before every action. The Chainlink price must be fresh, and the pool's thirty minute average must agree with it. When the feed freezes for the weekend and the token keeps trading, TORQUE stops.

The solvency invariants were written before the product code. Nine invariants, thirty two unit tests, and five tests against live mainnet state all pass. And the suite catches eighteen out of eighteen deliberately planted bugs.
USDG is not bolted on. It is the margin, the liquidity, the loan and the payout.

In this buildathon, Gauntlet offers leverage as an off chain game priced in ETH. TORQUE settles on chain, against the real NVDA price. Undertow's vault lends a stablecoin it mints itself, and has no deposits. TORQUE's counterparty is a real USDG vault, and every loan is secured by real NVDA.

TORQUE runs on Robinhood Chain mainnet, with the LP vault capped at twenty USDG for the buildathon. Testnet has no real stock feeds and no stock pools, so a testnet version would prove nothing. Small, and real. Next: shorts, more stocks, and a bigger vault.
